name: Qwen-Audio-3.1-Realtime-Plus
access: QwenCloud realtime API (WebSocket; AOQ and WebRTC also listed), Singapore-region API key

voice.input_audio: PCM 16-bit mono at 16 kHz (pcm is the only format); about 100 ms per chunk (3,200 bytes) is advised [qwencloud-audio-events] [qwencloud-audio-guide]
voice.output_audio: PCM 16-bit mono at 24 kHz (pcm is the only format) [qwencloud-audio-events] [qwencloud-audio-guide]
voice.voices: 13 system voices (default longanqian_v3.1; eight are new in 3.1) and cloned voices made with the voice-cloning API; the voice can be set only in the first session.update [qwencloud-audio-guide]
languages: Conversation: German, English, Spanish, French, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian and Chinese, with 21 Chinese varieties (Mandarin, Cantonese and regional speech)
session.input_audio_transcription.language takes 30 source-language codes and session.output_audio.language a target-language code for the speech (a best effort, not a guarantee)
voice.turn_detection: server_vad (default; threshold -1.0 to 1.0, default 0.5; silence_duration_ms 200 to 6000, default 800, 400 to 800 advised), smart_turn (acoustic and semantic; fillers such as uh or hmm do not start a turn), or null for push-to-talk; the mode can be set only before the first audio is sent [qwencloud-audio-ws] [qwencloud-audio-events]
voice.interruption: In server_vad and smart_turn modes new user speech cancels the running response (response.done with status cancelled); the client should clear its playback buffer on input_audio_buffer.speech_started; in smart_turn mode fillers and non-semantic sounds neither start a turn nor interrupt playback; optional speaker enhancement locks onto up to 5 reference voices [qwencloud-audio-guide] [qwencloud-audio-ws]
voice.latency: No figure from Alibaba; Artificial Analysis has no row for this model (read 2026-10-03); its row for the 3.0 Plus model shows 1.54 seconds to first audio [aa-s2s]
voice.session_limit: Not stated for this API; context of 262K tokens, and the model keeps at most 50 audio turns or 300 seconds of audio (default 20 turns, set with max_history_turns 1 to 50) [qwencloud-audio-guide] [qwencloud-page-audio31]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: QwenCloud model page (read 2026-10-03), per million tokens: audio input US$6.4 (the input field); text input US$0.8; text output US$6.4; text and audio output US$24 (the output field; output text is then not charged). The page lists a 2K maximum reasoning budget [qwencloud-page-audio31]
